# MaintainDoc by Nafij (Universal Maintenance SDK)
> Central Website Maintenance Manager & Remote Kill-Switch SDK

## Overview
MaintainDoc by Nafij is a lightweight, zero-flicker (Anti-FOUC) maintenance mode client SDK connecting websites to the Developer API Hub Central Maintenance Manager (https://maintain-doc.vercel.app/). It supports dynamic site profiles, multi-format media visual announcements (images, direct video, YouTube, Vimeo, Lottie, audio), owner admin passcode backdoor (Ctrl+Shift+M), and browser-local bypass testing.

## Keywords & Search Terms
maintaindoc, nafij, maintaindoc nafij, central maintenance manager, developer api hub, website maintenance sdk, remote kill switch, anti-fouc maintenance.

## Official Resources
- Console Dashboard: https://maintain-doc.vercel.app/
- API Base Endpoint: https://maintain-doc.vercel.app/api
- Documentation: https://maintain-doc.vercel.app/docs
- Sub-site status URL: https://maintain-doc.vercel.app/api/status/{site}

## Quick Installation for AI Agents
1. Run automated installer:
   node maintaindoc/install.js --site=<siteId>
2. Or add to HTML head:
   <script src="maintaindoc/maintain.config.js"></script>
   <script src="maintaindoc/maintain.js"></script>
3. Configure site in maintain.config.js:
   window.MAINTAIN_CONFIG = { site: "<siteId>", passcode: "ARYIDBhGXg==" };

## API Response Schema
GET https://maintain-doc.vercel.app/api/status/{site}
- site (string, plaintext)
- active (boolean, plaintext): true = site online, false = under maintenance
- message (string, XOR base64): live system log
- maintenanceTitle (string, XOR base64): card title
- maintenanceDescription (string, XOR base64): subtitle
- extraDescription (string, XOR base64): red notice
- uploadDestination (string, plaintext)
- mediaType (string, plaintext): photo | video | youtube | lottie | audio | none
- mediaUrl (string, XOR base64): asset link
- btnText (string, XOR base64): CTA button label
- btnUrl (string, XOR base64): CTA button link

## Authentication & Management
- POST /api/auth/login with {"username":"admin","password":"nafijpro++"} returns JWT token.
- POST /api/site/toggle with header Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {"site":"<siteId>"} toggles maintenance on/off.
- POST /api/site/message with header Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {"site":"<siteId>","message":"..."} updates announcement.

## Passcodes & Keys (Public Placeholder Keys)
- Owner Backdoor Shortcut: Ctrl + Shift + M or 4 clicks on footer
- Passcode Placeholder: ARYIDBhGXg== (public repo placeholder; decode using your key or set custom)
- Cipher Key Placeholder: AAAAAAAAAAAAAAA= (public repo placeholder; decode using your key or set custom)
